responsibility: Coordinates backend execution for rustc_codegen_cranelift by providing shared driver utilities to predeclare monomorphized items and hook Cranelift pass timing into rustc profiling, and by exposing the two execution modes built on top of that infrastructure: an ahead-of-time driver that schedules codegen units, handles incremental work products, assembles allocator/metadata modules, and emits object-based artifacts for rustc’s normal link pipeline, and a JIT driver that builds an in-memory module, compiles items eagerly or lazily, resolves external symbols from loaded dylibs, and runs the crate entry point through lazy recompilation callbacks.
